comments.author: Dukester
comments.body: It can be helpful to PPL if it says where we can buy the actual Spare Sails, so where are they?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
These can be found at pedlars in the following locations:

Northern Europe: Amsterdam, Oslo, St. Petersburg, Stockholm, Plymouth, London
Western Europe/Mediterranean: Algiers, Genoa, Seville, Tunis, Barcelona, Pisa, Marseille, Lisbon
Eastern Europe/Mediterrnean: Athens, Alexandria, Istanbul, Candia, Syracuse, Sevastopol, Naples, Ragusa, Venice
Africa: Luanda (West), Cape (South), Sofala (South)
Eastern Africa & Red Sea: Aden, Zanzibar, Muscat
India: Calicut, Goa
Southeast Asia: Jakarta, Manila
Caribbean: Santo Domingo, Havana, Portobelo
East Coast of Latin America: Veracruz, Bahia, Rio de Janeiro
East Asia: Anping, Hanyang, Hangzhou, Sakai
North America West Coast: San Francisco (not available until Gran Atlas Chapter 3)

Source: gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/TradeDB/action/ItemShow?id=242

You can also find a pedlar selling this item at the Ganador Command Center, which can be accessed from any port in the world by way of the Special Transport button.
